A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MENLO research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison. Repagination in v2 does not represent missing material.

before.justification: v1 reports original human annotations, judge evaluations, SFT/RL experiments, reward ablations, and automated/human evaluation of policy post-training (Tables 1 and 3–7; Appendix D).

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including judge-training comparisons, reward ablations, and the automated/human evaluation in Table 7, with detailed results in Appendix D.

M1.justification: Sections 2–5 retain the same MENLO construction, pairwise grading, SFT/GRPO judge training, composite rewards, and judge-based policy optimization. The prompt template and training procedures in Appendices B–C are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MENLO data across 47 language varieties and four quality dimensions. Policy post-training still excludes Localized Factuality, and human validation covers the same ten-language subset.

E2.justification: The same eight models participate in Tables 3–4, the same training variants appear in Tables 5 and 19–23, and Table 7 retains the same three automated judges and human raters. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Reported data splits, three-example few-shot prompting, randomized response ordering, evaluation metrics, training budgets, and policy-evaluation procedures are unchanged (Sections 3–5; Appendix C).

E4.justification: Both retain the rubric and reward-component ablations, single-task versus multi-task comparisons, English-only transfer experiment, language-specific analyses, and appendix examples. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Annotation agreement and rating-dispersion reporting remain unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run/seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests for model performance.

E6.justification: Results match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 5 retains Qwen3-4B RL Macro-F1 of 39.44 and preference accuracy of 60.02; Table 7 retains the human-rated post-training win rate of 55.71% and score increase of 0.36.

T1.justification: The formal composite-reward equation in Section 4.1 and the scoring/agreement definitions are unchanged. Moving the reward equation from v1 page 6 to v2 page 7 does not change its mathematics; no theoretical results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about MENLO, pairwise evaluation and rubrics, RL with reward shaping, and judge-driven policy improvement with remaining discrepancies from human judgment.

C2.justification: Both retain interpretations concerning pairwise comparisons as grounding, difficulty with localized factuality, weak English-only transfer, and automated judges overestimating human-rated improvements. No substantive explanation, limitation, or applicability boundary changes.

D1.justification: Appendices A–C retain the same annotation instructions, rubrics, judge template, libraries, learning rates, sequence limits, hardware, and checkpoint-selection details. Dataset-access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 6, Table 2, and the reference list retain the same cited works and positioning relative to multilingual datasets, judges, and reward models. No citation or novelty-positioning change is introduced.

P1.justification: v2 adds Francisco Guzmán to the author list with a Handshake AI/work-at-Meta footnote and removes the acknowledgment thanking Paco Guzmán for guidance on the project's original direction. The version/date stamp changes; scientific prose and section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Existing displays are retained with limited reflow and relocation. The reward equation moves to page 7; Appendix A redistributes Tables 9–12, placing Table 10 before Table 11 and moving Table 12 to page 17. Figure content and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 updates author credit and acknowledgments and reflows existing content. Methods, empirical evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. The limited layout changes produce no meaningful net difference in clarity or scientific support.
